bullets: Designed and developed 4+ Spring Boot microservices for enterprise finance workflows, enabling scalable distributed processing and reliable inter-service communication.
Engineered 20+ RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Swagger/OpenAPI; implemented Spring Security, JWT, and RBAC with JUnit and Mockito test coverage.
Improved application performance and resilience using Redis caching and Resilience4j Circuit Breaker/Retry patterns, reducing latency and improving fault tolerance across distributed services.
Implemented event-driven asynchronous workflows using Kafka and RabbitMQ for background processing and inter-service communication, improving throughput and application responsiveness.
Developed a multithreaded retry-abort framework using ExecutorService and ThreadPoolExecutor, improving failed-job reprocessing efficiency by 50% and reducing manual production intervention.

Designed a scalable data processing framework with user-configurable column-based sorting and dynamic partition orchestration, executing partitions concurrently to optimize performance and resource utilization.
Upgraded the Angular application from v7 to v17, resolving migration issues, refactoring TypeScript components, and improving UI workflows using RxJS Observables and Promises.
Remediated 10+ security vulnerabilities identified through SAST, DAST, and SonarLint, strengthening application security and compliance.
Automated month-end financial reporting using Python and SQL-based data pipelines, eliminating manual effort and saving 15+ hours per reporting cycle.
Resolved 40+ production incidents through root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and defect remediation; contributed to Agile/Scrum releases and AWS EC2/S3 and Docker deployments.
Presented 3+ technical PoCs, conducted 10+ client training sessions, and mentored 3 junior developers on architecture, coding standards, and development practices.
